notes.title: Major Update: New 3-Dice Weapon System Added – Gameplay Just Got Deeper! 🧠
notes.notes:
[p][b]🎲 Huge Gameplay Update: Introducing the 3-Dice Weapon System! 🔥[/b][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’re excited to announce a [b]major update[/b] to the [i]Ludaro[/i] demo — one that elevates the core gameplay with a fresh layer of strategy, planning, and satisfying decision-making.[/p][p]If you’ve already played [i]Ludaro[/i], you know it’s not just “roll and move.” Even before this update, [i]Ludaro[/i] was built around [b]deterministic dice[/b], [b]pre-roll prediction[/b], and [b]post-roll manipulation[/b] using Fate and Math cards. But now… we’re turning it up to eleven. 😎[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚀 What’s New?[/h3][p][b]The 3-Dice Weapon System[/b][/p][p]Every turn, you now roll [b]three dice[/b] — and each turn becomes a strategic puzzle:[/p][list][*][p][b]Choose one die[/b] to [b]move your pawn[/b] on the board.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Use the other two dice[/b] to [b]activate powerful weapons[/b] you’ve equipped.[/p][/*][/list][p]With [b]up to 6 different weapons[/b] equipped at once, each offering unique effects like:[/p][list][*][p]Gaining massive [b]points[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Boosting your [b]multiplier[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Earning [b]coins[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgrading tiles[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Or even getting [b]extra moves[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Every die matters — and [b]how[/b] you assign each one can change the course of the round (or your entire run).[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 Why This Changes Everything[/h3][p]This isn’t just a small tweak. This update transforms [i]Ludaro[/i] from a light tactical experience into a [b]full-fledged strategy roguelike[/b], where:[/p][list][*][p]Each turn presents a meaningful set of decisions[/p][/*][*][p]You constantly balance [b]short-term gains[/b] vs [b]long-term positioning[/b][/p][/*][*][p]You build [b]synergies[/b] between cards, Spirit effects, and now, your arsenal of weapons[/p][/*][/list][p]Think of it as a fusion of [b]Balatro’s build-crafting[/b], [b]Dicey Dungeons’ dice allocation[/b], and the familiar fun of Ludo — but remixed into something totally new.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧪 The Demo is Live – Try It Now![/h3][p]🎯 Play the updated demo and experience the new system for yourself:
👉 Play the Ludaro Demo on Steam[/p][p]💬 Drop your thoughts, feedback, or strategy combos in the Community Hub — we’re building this with you, and your voice genuinely matters.[/p][p]Let’s build the smartest, wildest, and most satisfying Ludo-inspired roguelike together. 🔥[/p][p]– Team EvolX Games[/p]
